scope: Official documentation review only. No OpenAlex API availability test, account creation, credentials inspection, payment or bulk baseline request.

sources.project_rule: Stop and report the first bibliographic API failure; do not follow the documentation suggestion to retry 429 automatically.

findings.group_by_cost: Same as underlying list/filter or search query.

findings: group_by returns key, key_display_name and count per bucket; filters can be combined with grouping.
Unknowns are omitted unless include_unknown is requested.
Group pagination uses cursor, not page, and is ordered by key during paging.

The grouping page states up to 200 groups/page; the general authentication page states per_page max 100. Use 100 conservatively until actual responses establish the endpoint-specific limit. No API test was performed here.
meta.groups_count counts only groups in the current page, not all groups.

findings.publication_date_semantics: Usually earliest electronic publication for the primary-location version; it is not a stated acceptance date.
findings.acceptance_date: No acceptance-date attribute is documented on this canonical work-attributes page.
findings.referenced_works_semantics: IDs of works cited by the focal work, not the works citing it.

findings: primary_location.source has source ID, name, ISSN-L, ISSNs and type, and can be null.
primary_location.source.id is documented as a filter key; location source attributes support grouping.
Version labels or is_accepted describe manuscript version status, not an acceptance date.

findings.issn_l: Links print and electronic ISSNs to a source; some sources lack ISSNs.
findings.interpretation: Publisher is a host organization, not one of these source types. Reports cannot be identified simply by mapping a source type to report.

findings: General works search covers titles, abstracts, full text and keywords.
Scoped search.title_and_abstract and search.title_abstract_keywords are documented separately.
Boolean operators must be uppercase, quoted phrases are supported, and ordinary search applies stemming.
A Web of Science Topic query includes fields unavailable in this exact form, so an OpenAlex climate corpus would be an explicitly redefined search population, not a reproduction of WoS coverage.
accepted is an optional acceptance-after-submission date.
published-print and published-online are optional publication dates; issued is the earlier publication date.
Partial dates can contain only a year. Missing months or accepted dates must remain missing.
The verified Lariviere response provides full print/online publication dates but no accepted key. This is one record, not a coverage estimate.
No sign-up is required; bibliographic metadata may be used for any purpose, with an explicit exception that some abstracts may be copyrighted.
An article record license field concerns the article content/version; the Crossref website footer license concerns its documentation. Neither establishes that every response field has a CC0 license.
Clarivate says API use depends on the user agreement and directs specific usage questions to customer support.
The FAQ lists selected public-facing institutional applications as uses of legacy APIs; this does not establish permission to redistribute a complete exported research database on GitHub.
sources.repository_redistribution_permission: Not established: the applicable institutional order, product terms and permission were not provided.

findings: Expanded API access requires a paid license, and plans are configured according to the institutional contract.
Requesting credentials binds users to portal and product/service terms; no credentials were requested here.

sources.access: official indexed summary readable; direct browser fetch returned HTTP 403
findings: The official product-terms index lists separate Web of Science API, custom-dataset and persistently/perpetually licensed-information terms, additional to the general Clarivate terms.
sources.unverified: The actual applicable product text and user-specific order were not retrieved. No legal permission conclusion is drawn.

findings: The default query population is the curated core corpus; the expansion corpus is opt-in with corpus=all. Record the chosen corpus explicitly when freezing an external baseline.
Web of Science Topic searches title, abstract, author keywords and Keywords Plus. OpenAlex scoped title-and-abstract search does not reproduce all these fields.

status_distinction: Documentation page failures above are not failures of a bibliographic API request. The only bibliographic API request in this task succeeded (Crossref DOI lookup, HTTP 200).
baseline_feasibility: Aggregate publication-year and source distributions are documented. A frozen climate-search definition, verified access for all cursor pages, query cost/budget and actual field availability must be established before collecting a baseline. No baseline counts or effects were generated.
legal_scope: Source documentation and unresolved permissions only; no contract review or legal certification.
